item.title: ‘Please use your Bluetooth': MSP cracking down on distracted driving
item.description: April is Distracted Driving Awareness Month. Michigan State Police is enforcing the ‘U Drive. U Text. U Pay.’ nationwide campaign.

item.title: July 29 in National Lasagna Day
item.description: The best way to join in National Lasagna Day on July 29th is to bake up a pan of the Italian pasta dish.

item.title: Northville farm raising funds to feed animals during off-season
item.description: From animals to corn mazes, folks can expect lots at the Maybury Farm in Northville, the non-profit aims to create more awareness about farming

item.title: Individual arrested after shots fired at family event in Dearborn
item.description: Dearborn Police got a call at 7:14 p.m. about reports of a shooting at a family event hosted at Dearborn Manor Banquet, 5101 Oakman Blvd

item.title: Dave LewAllen inducted into Central Michigan University Media Hall of Fame
item.description: Over the weekend, LewAllen’s alma mater showed appreciation for their exemplary graduate by inducting him into the CMU Media Hall of Fame. The Emmy-winning journalist was honored to be recognized.

item.title: Downtown Detroit gym honors Veterans Day by organizing a rowing challenge to benefit cancer survivors
item.description: To honor Veterans Day, a local gym in Downtown Detroit held a rowing competition called the Million Meter Row Challenge for folks with various athletic abilities

item.description: 19-year-old Evan Allen is overcoming his frustration at Azra Chamber of Horrors due to the Lions narrowly missing the Super Bowl

item.title: Detroit Historical Museum unveils unique Detroit Pistons exhibit
item.description: Detroit Historical Museum unveils a unique Pistons exhibit to celebrate the 35th anniversary of the 1989 Bad Boys, and 2004 'Going to Work' eras

item.title: Another WXYZ-TV standout enters Michigan Broadcasting Hall of Fame
item.description: Distinguished journalist Dave LewAllen is adding another well-earned honor to his list of accolades. The longtime WXYZ-TV anchor will be inducted into the Michigan Broadcasting Hall of Fame in August.
